author_single_switch_summary_20260504.conclusion: author 基线单开关/no-new-data 队列已覆盖；pairwise loss 四 seed GAUC 均值仍高于旧保护候选，但最低 seed 略低于旧保护候选且 LogLoss/校准风险明显；其余单开关不推广、拒绝或 no-op。若业务目标同时重视 LogLoss/校准，不建议直接替换为 pairwise loss。

author_pairwise_loss_multiseed_summary_2.conclusion: GAUC 口径边界通过：author + pairwise loss 四 seed 测试 GAUC 均值 0.660820，高于旧保护候选 0.660225 和单独 author 0.658705；但 seed-2028=0.660215 略低于旧保护候选，最低值不再全超过，且 LogLoss 均值 0.593974 明显弱于 author。若业务目标包含校准/LogLoss，不应直接替换。

stability_confirm_summary_20260503.conclusion: gate008 mean is below protected; no_psrg_no_pcrg mean is effectively tied with protected but within seed noise and has worse average LogLoss, so neither is promoted.

author_pairwise_calibration_repair_20260.single_variable_change: turn on use_rank_calib_split while keeping use_pairwise_loss=true
author_pairwise_calibration_repair_20260.conclusion: rank_calib_split gives a modest final LogLoss improvement versus pairwise_loss average, but final LogLoss remains worse than author and final GAUC falls below old protection and pairwise 4-seed min; ranking branch is much worse. Do not promote; pairwise calibration risk remains unresolved.

author_pairwise_weight_sweep_20260504.single_variable_change: set pairwise_loss_weight from trainer default 0.1 to 0.05 while keeping use_pairwise_loss=true
author_pairwise_weight_sweep_20260504.conclusion: Do not promote and do not continue seed2027: seed2025 was promising, but seed2026 regressed. Two-seed GAUC mean=0.660133 and min=0.659229 are below the old protected candidate 0.660225, and LogLoss mean=0.592100 is still worse than author baseline 0.591782. Weight 0.05 reduces LogLoss damage vs original pairwise but does not provide stable promotion signal.

w002.single_variable_change: set pairwise_loss_weight from trainer default 0.1 to 0.02 while keeping use_pairwise_loss=true
w002.conclusion: Not promoted; too weak to keep pairwise GAUC benefit and still not better than author LogLoss.

author_pairwise_weight_sweep_20260504.final_conclusion: Pairwise weight repair did not produce a stable promotable setting. Weight 0.05 had a strong seed2025 but failed seed2026 confirmation; weight 0.02 reduced the signal further with GAUC below old protected and LogLoss still worse than author. Stop this weight sweep unless explicitly requested.

author_pairwise_mode_sweep_20260504.single_variable_change: set pairwise_loss_mode from trainer default hardest to all_pairs while keeping use_pairwise_loss=true and pairwise_loss_weight at default 0.1
author_pairwise_mode_sweep_20260504.conclusion: all_pairs keeps a strong single-seed GAUC signal, but it does not repair LogLoss/calibration; LogLoss is effectively the same as original hardest pairwise and worse than author and w005. Do not seed-confirm for calibration repair unless the business explicitly chooses GAUC-only optimization.

author_pcrg_token_gate_combo_20260504.single_variable_change: turn on use_side_attention_gate on top of author_pcrg_token
author_pcrg_token_gate_combo_20260504.conclusion: The combo improves over author baseline and side_attention_gate seed2025 while preserving good LogLoss, but it underperforms author_pcrg_token seed2025 and old protection by GAUC. Do not seed-confirm or promote.

author_pcrg_token_zero_init_bias_2026050.single_variable_change: turn on zero_init_side_attention_bias on top of author_pcrg_token
author_pcrg_token_zero_init_bias_2026050.conclusion: zero_init_side_attention_bias badly hurts ranking when added to author_pcrg_token and does not improve LogLoss. Reject; do not seed-confirm.

semantic_highpoint_fair_confirm_and_prot.selection_rule: eligible candidates require all seeds 2025-2028; rank by mean test GAUC, then min test GAUC, then lower mean LogLoss
semantic_highpoint_fair_confirm_and_prot.conclusion: Fair confirmation selects semantic_simtier_sem48_slicegate_reg_mid by mean GAUC. The train+valid merged no-validation run is the strongest current protected candidate. Conservative CCSS improves over the fair-confirmation mean but underperforms the no-validation protected run, so it is not promoted as the protected model.
